 Toronto Raptors guard RJ Barrett drives against Milwaukee Bucks forward Jaime Jaquez Jr. | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect Predicting the Raptors Starting Lineup With RJ Barrett, Collin Murray-Boyles Injured 
 The Toronto Raptors are going to dig deep with several key players sidelined due to injury. Jeremy Brener | Share on Facebook Share on X Add us as a preferred source Toronto Raptors guard RJ Barrett drives against Milwaukee Bucks forward Jaime Jaquez Jr. | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect In this story:
 Toronto Raptors The Toronto Raptors will debut a new starting lineup for their game against the Detroit Pistons at Little Caesars Arena. 
--> The Toronto Raptors will debut a new starting lineup for their game against the Detroit Pistons at Little Caesars Arena. 
 The Raptors are playing their second game without RJ Barrett, who has been diagnosed with a hamstring strain and will be missing at least the next two weeks. 
--> The Raptors are playing their second game without RJ Barrett, who has been diagnosed with a hamstring strain and will be missing at least the next two weeks. 
 Barrett's absence is coupled with Kawhi Leonard and Collin Murray-Boyles, who exited the last game against the Washington Wizards with an illness that eventually was revealed to be concussion-like symptoms. CMB entered the league's concussion protocol, which has him sidelined for the game. 
--> Barrett's absence is coupled with Kawhi Leonard and Collin Murray-Boyles, who exited the last game against the Washington Wizards with an illness that eventually was revealed to be concussion-like symptoms. CMB entered the league's concussion protocol, which has him sidelined for the game. 
 Here's a look at a potential starting lineup for the Raptors against the Pistons. 
--> Here's a look at a potential starting lineup for the Raptors against the Pistons. 
 PG Immanuel Quickley
--> PG Immanuel Quickley
 Toronto Raptors guard Immanuel Quickley dribbles against Khris Middleton of the Washington Wizards. | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect Immanuel Quickley has been the team's starting point guard the entire season so far, and nothing is going to change on that front against the Pistons. 
--> Immanuel Quickley has been the team's starting point guard the entire season so far, and nothing is going to change on that front against the Pistons. 
 Quickley is having to take on a larger load with three of the top six players on the sidelines, and going up against Cade Cunningham will only force him to be on his A-game even more. 
--> Quickley is having to take on a larger load with three of the top six players on the sidelines, and going up against Cade Cunningham will only force him to be on his A-game even more. 
 SG Ja'Kobe Walter
--> SG Ja'Kobe Walter
 Toronto Raptors guard Ja'Kobe Walter dunks the ball against the New York Knicks. | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect Ever since Leonard has been out, Ja'Kobe Walter has stepped into the starting lineup, and he has done a great job. As a starter, the third-year pro averages 12.8 points per game while making 37.2 per cent of his 3-point looks. 
--> Ever since Leonard has been out, Ja'Kobe Walter has stepped into the starting lineup, and he has done a great job. As a starter, the third-year pro averages 12.8 points per game while making 37.2 per cent of his 3-point looks. 
 Walter has averaged 21.5 points per game in the last two contests, which means he is getting more comfortable in his role and is taking on the challenge of a larger offensive responsibility.
--> Walter has averaged 21.5 points per game in the last two contests, which means he is getting more comfortable in his role and is taking on the challenge of a larger offensive responsibility.
 C Jakob Poeltl
--> C Jakob Poeltl
 Toronto Raptors center Jakob Poeltl shoots against Philadelphia 76ers center Joel Embiid. | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect With CMB on the sidelines, the Raptors have no choice but to go with Jakob Poeltl as the starting center. 
--> With CMB on the sidelines, the Raptors have no choice but to go with Jakob Poeltl as the starting center. 
 The team will also have Trayce Jackson-Davis and Allen Graves play in his backup minutes, but Poeltl might have to take on a larger role than he has over the last couple of games. 
--> The team will also have Trayce Jackson-Davis and Allen Graves play in his backup minutes, but Poeltl might have to take on a larger role than he has over the last couple of games. 
 PF Scottie Barnes
--> PF Scottie Barnes
 Toronto Raptors forward Scottie Barnes dribbles the ball against New York Knicks guard Mikal Bridges. | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect Barnes is back after missing five of the team's last seven games with an illness and a groin injury, but he has had two full days of rest between now and his last game against the New York Knicks, where he scored 20 points against the defending champions.
--> Barnes is back after missing five of the team's last seven games with an illness and a groin injury, but he has had two full days of rest between now and his last game against the New York Knicks, where he scored 20 points against the defending champions.
 Barrett's absence puts more of the offensive burden on his shoulders, and he is going to need to be the offensive engine in order for them to pull off the upset against the Pistons.
--> Barrett's absence puts more of the offensive burden on his shoulders, and he is going to need to be the offensive engine in order for them to pull off the upset against the Pistons.
 SF Jamison Battle
--> SF Jamison Battle
 Toronto Raptors forward Jamison Battle shoots against the Philadelphia 76ers. | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect Barrett's removal from the starting lineup will force the Raptors to go with someone new, and Jamison Battle appears to be the likeliest candidate for the position. Battle started in the team's previous game against the Wizards, where he scored 19 points on 7 of 15 shooting, including 5 of 10 from downtown.
--> Barrett's removal from the starting lineup will force the Raptors to go with someone new, and Jamison Battle appears to be the likeliest candidate for the position. Battle started in the team's previous game against the Wizards, where he scored 19 points on 7 of 15 shooting, including 5 of 10 from downtown.
 Having a three-point threat in the starting lineup will force the Pistons to play a different type of defense, which could open things up for Barnes as he tries to drive into the lane. This makes Battle the likeliest player to join that starting lineup, but Graves could also be an option.
